limitations: Only B/D0/RSI-lambda1 and Anchor are present; existing partial workpoint flags cannot establish the complete pilot working points.
The same development val selected these checkpoints; intervals are exploratory, not independent confirmation.
H and strict T1 evaluate shared image outputs with independently selected source references; they are not additional training or selection cohorts.
Worst-tail CI independently reranks min-reference gain within every group bootstrap draw and takes ceil(10% resampled image count).
Core FixedShrink already reproduces aggregate Dice/G+/Hε closely; these partial results cannot establish a unique RSI mechanism or beat all simple controls.

Original summarizer CSV retains undefined conditional-rate nan cells for zero denominators. This JSON represents those cells with null; no finite metric is changed and no undefined value is replaced with zero.
interpretation_zh: 在checkpoint-selected M开发验证集上，RSI相对D0的Dice差很小且病例配对区间跨0；Hε及最差10%参考收益尾部改善，G+也同步下降。BF1三个容差宏均值均提高，其中0.5%和1%容差的配对区间在0以上，0.25%区间跨0；像素HD95基本相同，归一化HD95略升且配对区间跨0。H与严格T1小来源队列Dice分别低约0.00420/0.00267，且同一批图像改用M参考也低约0.00398/0.00295，因此不能把下降仅归因于参考来源改变；H/T1均出现像素HD95宏均值升高，严格T1 BF1宏均值下降，需要保留为敏感性风险，不能据此重选工作点。尚无完整simplecontrol工作点，FixedShrink核心已基本复现Dice/G+/Hε，不能认定RSI独有机制。
